column1: # CI routing (C-07 closeout) — verifier parity over the retained evidence store. Run 2026-11-18, read-only on the store.
# Population: 228 bundle directories under /workspace/udg-evidence (every directory holding a report.json: 220 under ci-run-* capture folders, 8 at the store root).
# Verifier A: tools/checks built at the baseline commit b2efee21caca6a4a7fe4be15d6b40e2ae6edd66a (a detached worktree; node_modules shared from the working tree, lockfile identical).
# Verifier B: tools/checks built at the candidate commit 6d91c61 (this branch). The two trees differ in parseCiActions only, plus docs, workflows and tests.
# Command, both sides: node tools/checks/dist/evidence.js verify --run <absolute bundle directory> --report <file under /tmp, outside the store>.
# Baseline verifier: 193 PASS / 35 FAIL.   Candidate verifier: 193 PASS / 35 FAIL.   Verdict or issue-count differences: 0.
# Historical FAILs are in the population and are reported with their original issue codes; none was re-run, re-judged or repaired.

# Non-mutation, measured: a manifest of every file in the store (path|size|mtime, 14927 files) is 7851bd3d3b4045bc539c0ce1021dd3cf51be77e8426104b4e07ae8a6498cf32e before and after a full pass of verifier B, same file count.
